description: This bar chart illustrates accuracy evaluations for different tasks, specifically “MCQ Eval” and “Generation Eval”, across three model configurations. The horizontal axis represents the task categories, labeled “MCQ Eval” and “Generation Eval” in that order, while the vertical axis represents “Accuracy” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. For each task, there are three bars representing “Base” (brown), “RMU with Enhanced GCG” (olive green), and “RMU” (light tan). Within each task, the bars are grouped side-by-side. For “MCQ Eval”, the “Base” bar reaches a value of 0.644, the “RMU with Enhanced GCG” bar reaches 0.539, and the “RMU” bar reaches 0.299. For “Generation Eval”, the “Base” bar reaches a value of 0.597, the “RMU with Enhanced GCG” bar reaches 0.263, and the “RMU” bar reaches 0.106. The bars are arranged in the order of the legend, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
